question: Purely Organic Foods brand manufacturer company
markdown:
Purely Organic Foods
is
a family-owned and operated natural and organic food brand and distributor based in Surrey, British Columbia, Canada
. They specialize in sourcing and delivering chemical-free pantry staples, including superfood powders, spices, nuts, seeds, and natural sweeteners
(Note: If you were referring to
Pure Life Organic Foods
, they are a separate global bulk-ingredient manufacturer handling farm-to-fork organic starches and sweeteners. Another notable brand,
Pure Organic
, is well-known in the United States for organic layered fruit bars and snack bites.)
Pure Life Organic Foods
Core Product Offerings
Organic spices and seasonings
Premium nuts and dried fruits
Seeds and superfood powders
Natural sweeteners and baking essentials
Company Highlights
Location:
Surrey, British Columbia, Canada
Focus:
Chemical-free, non-GMO, and clean-ingredient foods
Operations:
Direct-to-consumer and Canada-wide delivery
